content.title: Speaking Test 15 — Decisions
content.description: The full three-part interview: photographs in Part 1, a long turn on “Describe an important decision you had to make”, then a discussion of making decisions and advice and influence.

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's talk about photographs.

Do you often take photographs? [Why/Why not?]
What kind of photographs do you like to take? [Why?]
Do you prefer to keep photographs on your phone or to print them? [Why?]
Have you ever framed a photograph to put on a wall? [Why/Why not?]
Describe an important decision you had to make.
bulletsHtml: when you had to make it
and explain why the decision was important

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's consider making decisions.

Why do some people find it hard to make up their minds?
Is it better to make a decision quickly or to take time over it?
Do you think people make better decisions as they get older?

Let's consider advice and influence.

Who do people usually turn to for advice about important matters?
Do you agree that parents should make big decisions for their children?
How much are people's decisions influenced by advertising?
